annotations.annotation_text: Time points are relative to dosing (0 hours).
Hour 24 PK/PD sampling is to occur just prior to the next-day dose of ALXN1840.

Note: Windows for PK/PD time points will be defined as ±10% of the nominal time point. On Days 1 and 39, triplicate 12-lead ECG will be collected at 4 hours postdose. When multiple procedures are scheduled to occur at the same time, the following order of events should be strictly adhered to whenever possible: ECG, vital signs, blood sampling (eg, for PK/PD), study intervention administration, and meal.
